title: Dates & family events
description: Date differences, workdays and birthday or anniversary countdowns.
invalidImport: Invalid format or size limit exceeded. Existing data was preserved.
range: Workday ranges must be ordered and no longer than 3,660 days.
uncovered: The range includes years without holiday coverage. Maintain those years or select weekdays only.
saveError: Save failed. Check required fields and browser storage.
readError: Cannot read local data. Writes are disabled to preserve it.
imported: Imported. Matching event IDs keep their local version; the holiday calendar was replaced.
countHint: Date difference is end minus start, independent of endpoint options. Workdays use the selected endpoints; a same-day range counts only if both are included. Workdays are not securities trading days.
local: Stored in this browser only, with annual Gregorian recurrence. Export before clearing browser data. No background reminders or automatic device sync.
maintenanceHint: The default calendar covers 2026. Enter comma-separated years only when fully verified. Add holidays and makeup workdays; other dates use the weekend rule. Save to apply changes; use an HTTPS source URL. Importing a backup replaces this calendar.
